articles.title: A Space Telescope That Could Find 100,000 New Planets!
articles.summary: NASA's Roman telescope might discover 100,000 hidden worlds—way more than the 6,300 we know. It will peek into unexplored parts of our galaxy, like the busy center, to see how planets form in different neighborhoods.

articles.title: The Robot with Air Muscles That Wore Pants!
articles.summary: In the 1980s, a hobbyist built a life-size walking robot using 'air-muscles' instead of motors. Named Shadow Walker, it stood on its own and even competed in the 1990 Robot Olympics—wearing pants to hide its secret tech!

articles.title: Eagle Mom Slaps a Squirrel—and the Internet Can't Look Away!
articles.summary: Bald eagle Jackie gave a squirrel named Fiona a dramatic slap when it visited her nest at night. The livestream moment shows how fiercely eagle parents protect their chicks, Sandy and Luna, from even the smallest intruders.
